capabilities.summary: Now-playing state publication and media-key / transport command intake for native playback over souvlaki (SMTC, Now Playing, MPRIS), with the one-owner rule enforced: a web view that plays media owns the keys through the page's media session
policyNotes: Declaration-only: media-session registration is not an ownership fingerprint.
rightkit-automation::media_keys::send_media_key only sends keys; this crate publishes state and receives commands.
